pillars.name: card precision + C8 maturity
pillars.rule: mtime-window provenance: a file whose mtime lies inside one of this session's shell tool-call windows after its last own edit is unknown, not foreign; pre-session foreign hunks stay foreign (arm C must stay 2/2 GREEN). Gate replays the 5 live false denies (300ac3a1, 5b36b02f x2, 3a05f288, 4a7ee8bc) as allowed AND keeps a pre-session foreign hunk denied; the 'git exit 128' x6 class is root-caused and named. C8 target is a delivery card (deny-once question), never an authority.

pillars.name: listing floor + plugin gateway + economics
pillars.rule: listing hiding was falsified twice (C6, K4) against D-LISTING; a third hypothesis closes this pillar only with its own measurement against D-LISTING recording the command; a lower floor claimed without a fresh-session measurement is refused

pillars.name: opportunity / delivery / recall / precision
pillars.rule: opportunity, delivery, recall and precision are computed by one gate from transcripts over a named window; recall and precision report n and are never extrapolated from n < 5

pillars.name: coverage + criticality
pillars.rule: every installed skill gets a coverage class (opportunity detector / card / none) and a criticality class from a discovered sweep, never a hand list

pillars.name: contribution + result consumption
pillars.rule: contribution is claimed only from a paired benchmark inside the <= 10 new-session budget (D-SESSIONS); otherwise the measurement records why the budget cannot separate the arms

pillars.name: disclosure / fission / fusion / inline / dedup
pillars.rule: each representation operation applied to a skill carries a before/after listing measurement against D-LISTING and a recall check; dedup decisions come from a content-hash sweep

pillars.name: compile-out + lineage
pillars.rule: a compiled-out card names the skill and commit it was compiled from, and a gate fails when the source skill changes without the card being re-derived

pillars.name: freshness / drift / recert
pillars.rule: drift between a skill's live copy and its repo mirror, and between a card and its source, is detected by a gate driven from both poles

pillars.name: lifecycle / retirement / self-pruning / GC
pillars.rule: merged into cognitive-economy pillar T; this program hands over its retirement candidates with evidence and deletes nothing

pillars.name: creation governance
pillars.rule: a new skill must declare its opportunity detector or why it has none; a gate refuses a skill directory without the declaration

pillars.name: capability routing + ACV
pillars.rule: routing lives with ACV; this program contributes opportunity rows through CO-12 and builds no second router

pillars.name: CO-12 + Context Compiler
pillars.rule: the Context Compiler is ABSENT; it is deferred to the cognitive-economy program with a handoff; CO-12 is written only through record_signal

pillars.name: economics / model / goal relativity
pillars.rule: cost figures come from tools/usage_index.py windows; this program reports token and turn deltas relative to a named denominator and owns no cost model

pillars.name: CBR / UBC / UKDL / settings / push closeout
pillars.rule: closeout: UKDL and CBR reviews exist, global settings equal the declared retained state (wrapper --final check), and push happens only once no foreign commits interleave (Owner boundary 4)

C.reason: D-01: one gate (tools/test_skill_delivery.py) derives opportunity, delivery, recall and precision through the extended owner tools/skill_invocations.py, with row-time window bounds. D-02 window F (known-answer fixture): 9 opportunities, 7 measured, delivery recall 4/7 (n=7), precision at n=4 not estimated; window L (pinned laptop pack): card precision 0/5 (n=5) over D-CARD with 4615e1d1 unlabelled beside it, recall 6/6 selection-bound, population recall unmeasured on gex44; window G (gex44 recorded 7 days): 31 model and 23 typed invocations measured, opportunity unmeasured because gex44 has no card ledger. D-03: the gate is driven red by named mutants and by one subprocess run (53/53 clauses). Observed on host gex44; this pillar measures and claims no saving.

D.reason: D-01: one discovered sweep (tools/skill_coverage.py, gated by tools/test_skill_coverage.py, 17/17 clauses after the phase 4 review fixes) gives every skill a coverage class derived from the dispatcher registrations and adapter source, and a criticality class from plane-labelled evidence; planes are never summed. Repo plane: 24 skills, opportunity_detector 1, card 1, none 22; criticality high 0, medium 4, low 20. Host gex44 live plane (recorded in D-live-gex44.json): 161 skills (directories holding SKILL.md; 24 other directories are listed by name as non_skill_dirs and never classified), opportunity_detector 1, card 1, none 159; criticality high 11, medium 5, low 145; 9 skills are high criticality with coverage none (the 8 rule stubs plus claude-power-pack, whose router line in ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md sits in the HARD RULES section). The gate drives two positive controls, four drills (detector unregistered, adapter removed, card unregistered, stubs removed), synthetic paths, CRLF copies and an empty recording that reads INCONCLUSIVE, never all none; a mutated dispatcher turns the gate red (D-03). Observed on host gex44; the laptop live plane is an Owner-bundle item. This pillar measures and claims no saving.

E.reason: D-01: the committed CWST paired benchmark (host laptop, n=2 per arm, rows at 123c96cc) gives authoritative passes N0 0/2, R 0/2, P 0/2, C 0/2. The 1 stored PASS in arm P regrades FAIL-SWALLOW-REPAIRED (713b02a7), so the largest effect between arms is 0 (0 points) under the authoritative grades and 1/2 (50 points) under the stored grades. D-02: within the D-SESSIONS cap of 10 new sessions (0 consumed as stated, 10 remaining), the exact two-sided Fisher test at alpha 1/20 separates no effect below 3/4 (75 points) under any allocation, and none below 4/5 (80 points) at 5 vs 5. No allocation can separate the committed effect, so no contribution is claimed on the committed rows; a benchmark that could separate the stored-grade effect needs a smallest total of 15 sessions (6 vs 9; 20 at equal allocation), above the cap. The frozen D-CARD.arm_c C-fixed figure 2/2 PASS has no committed row; judged by the same verdict rule against N0 0/2 it is an effect of 1 (100 points), which the budget could separate (SEPARABLE, 4 per arm, 8 sessions; smallest total 7), inside the cap, so whether to run it is an Owner decision ([E] line). Result consumption: the skill was invoked in 0 of 8 measured rows, and no rate is estimated at n < 5. D-03: 0 sessions consumed in this phase. The rows come from host laptop, and the derivation runs on host gex44. This pillar claims no saving.

F.reason: D-03: one gate (tools/test_skill_representation.py, 15/15 clauses) judges pillar F from committed blobs. D-01 sweep (F-sweep-gex44.json): repo plane 24 skills of 24 entries re-derived from the blobs at repo_commit 01f4182a; host gex44 plane 161 skills of 186 entries, with 24 directories without SKILL.md and 1 non-directory entry counted by name, not dropped. Each skill is hashed by its SKILL.md body and by its whole directory; planes are never merged. One dedup candidate group: managing-sleepy-skills + sleepy-skills on gex44 (identical SKILL.md body, both declare the frontmatter name managing-sleepy-skills, managing-sleepy-skills is a file subset of sleepy-skills); its laptop listing status is UNMEASURED (not in the K4 watch set) and its upper bound is 1 listing entry on the gex44 plane, which is not a D-LISTING figure. 14 repo skills mirrored identically on gex44 are kept apart as drift (pillar H), not dedup. Operation gate (f-operations.json): an entry carries references, not figures (a D-LISTING probe row by label and session id, committed recall windows, and the applied_commit, an ancestor of HEAD whose committer time must fall between the before window's end and the after window's start); the gate derives every figure, admits a dedup only from a committed sweep group, and refuses an operation unless the after startup tokens plus the 1500 noise are below the before figure and recall does not drop. The gate prints 32 drills (3 positive controls, 27 refusals red by FAIL, 2 INCONCLUSIVE expectations) + 3 entry-status lines (2 INCONCLUSIVE, 1 FAIL): each refusal is red by FAIL on its own clause, each INCONCLUSIVE expectation (unsourced noise, git unable to answer) reads INCONCLUSIVE on its own clause, and each positive control (one on a real ancestor commit) passes every clause; the real K4 rows recast as a disclosure are refused as not measured to help (after 89844 + 1500 >= before 87739). 0 operations applied on host gex44 (D-01): D-LISTING measures the laptop listing and needs fresh laptop sessions, the D-SESSIONS listing family (8 of 12 remaining) is untouched by this phase, and listing hiding was falsified twice (C6, K4). Observed on host gex44; this pillar claims no saving.

G.reason: D-04: each compiled-out card carries one COMPILED-FROM trailer per skill it names (skill, source path, the LF sha256 of the committed SKILL.md, the source commit) as the last lines of the card, and tools/card_lineage.py judges it from committed blobs only, gated by tools/test_card_lineage.py (40/40 clauses after the phase 6 review fixes). Population is discovered from the committed tree (every hooks/**/*.js outside the test trees), never listed: 2 cards, hooks/doctrine_cards.js (concurrent-writers-shared-tree) and hooks/destructive_doctrine_card.js (destructive-state-authorization), each naming one skill. 10 clauses: 7 per card (TRAILER, SKILL, SOURCE-PATH, SOURCE-CURRENT, COMMIT-ANCESTOR, COMMIT-TOUCHES, COMMIT-DIGEST) and 3 for the gate (FLOOR, DISPATCHER-COVERED, H-RECORD-CURRENT); SKILL requires a trailer for every skill the card names, DISPATCHER-COVERED reads both CHAIN_MAP registration shapes, and a working-tree-only change is not judged, only the committed blob. 32 tamper drills in temp git repos each reproduce their declared verdict and fail set exactly (among them a card naming a second skill whose change fails SOURCE-CURRENT after H's re-record, a merge commit named by --trailer-for accepted, and a subdirectory card registered as ./<rel> caught); an unmeasured outcome is checked as UNMEASURED rather than FAIL; git missing, one git subcommand failing inside a clause, and a shallow clone lacking the trailer commits each give INCONCLUSIVE, never FAIL. Load-bearing: forcing each of the 10 clauses to PASS flips its singleton drill FAIL to PASS and back on restore (TRAILER's singleton is TRAILER-NOT-LAST); separately, narrowing the population to marker-carrying members flips UNLINEAGED-CARD, and TRAILER forced PASS on TRAILER-ABSENT stays FAIL on SKILL; outside the gate, re-measured on the 40-clause gate, a COMMIT-DIGEST-always-PASS mutant turned 8 checks red (32/40) and a worktree-reading SOURCE-CURRENT mutant turned 3 red including WORKTREE-ONLY (37/40). Core result: a source skill change fails SOURCE-CURRENT even after pillar H's record is re-recorded, and clears only when the trailer is re-derived. H's record and render were re-derived in 06-01 through H's own re-derivation act and both state.H pins moved; card_source_digests.json is pinned here at the same bytes state.H pins. G-lineage.md is the committed render, equal to the gate's own render. Observed on host gex44 (gate about 5.0 s); the laptop plane (live hook copies, gate runtime there, the re-derivation duty) is in the Owner bundle as [G] items. No saving claimed: lineage is a correctness property.
